item.title: TTT 334: Cuddle Up
item.description: Happy 2013 from Tip Tap Tip! We’re still here in case you missed us over the holiday. We have lots to talk about like; Eurovision 2013, Cuddle parties and naughty license plates. Here’s to another year of being Calgary’s best podcast. Thanks for all your support and big thanks to all the other Calgary podcasts out there who haven’t emailed us yet to tell us we’re full of shit. WE DO THIS FOR YOU!
